Today, in addition to launching two new products, Sonos also announced a new brand for its software platform, "Sonos 27," and detailed four new features rolling out this fall.

Here are the four new "Sonos 27" features launching this fall

Today, Sonos not only unveiled the Sonos Ace Ultra headphones but also introduced the Sonos Beam Ultra speaker. Beyond new hardware, the company has also reimagined its software brand.

"Sonos 27" is the official name of Sonos's software platform. The platform itself has existed for some time, but starting today it has a formal brand identity. In addition to the rebranding, Sonos also announced four new software features coming to users this fall:

  • Portable Surround Sound
  • Personal Listening
  • Sonos 27 Voice
  • Sonos MCP

Portable Surround Sound

To learn more about these new Sonos 27 features, including specific rollout dates and early access programs, visit the official Sonos website.
